sources.title: Connected knowledge sources
sources.subtitle: Connect documents so the system can automatically read, chunk, embed, and update approved guidance for the chatbot.
sources.simpleSubtitle: The system checks each Google Drive source every 10 minutes. It downloads, embeds, and replaces the active version only when its checksum changes.

oauth.connectedMessage: Google Drive is connected. You can now choose documents directly.
oauth.cancelledMessage: Google connection was closed or declined. Nothing was changed.

sources.deleteConfirmation: The system will delete {{name}}, every document version, and all generated chunks from the database, then remove related vectors. A minimal audit record is retained.
sources.createHint: Choose a document. Saving automatically reads, chunks, embeds, and approves it for customer support chatbot use.

automatic.supportedHint: If you choose another type, the system identifies it and explains the problem before saving.
automatic.noSelection: No document selected. Its name and type will be filled automatically.
automatic.unsupportedTitle: This document type is not supported
automatic.unsupportedHint: {{name}} is not a Google Doc, Google Sheet, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, or CSV file. Choose another document.

sources.safetyHint: The system only reads files you explicitly choose, stores checksums and versions, and replaces data only when content changes. Superseded versions stop being used so the chatbot does not cite old content.

fields.name: Source name

fields.googleUrlHint: Paste the sharing link from Google Docs, Google Sheets, or a Drive file.
